mapper.sql: (SELECT MAX(s.SANCTION_TYPE) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY s.CREATED_AT, s.SANCTION_ID) FROM SANCTION s WHERE s.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND s.SANCTION_TYPE IN ('CHAT_RESTRICT', 'CHAT_RELEASE') AND (s.GROUP_ID IS NULL OR s.GROUP_ID = g.GROUP_ID))
mapper.select: SELECT g.STATUS AS GROUP_STATUS, gm.STATUS AS MEMBER_STATUS, gm.CHAT_RESTRICTED_YN AS CHAT_RESTRICTED_YN, AS LAST_CHAT_SANCTION FROM GYE_GROUP g LEFT JOIN GYE_MEMBER gm ON gm.GROUP_ID = g.GROUP_ID AND gm.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} WHERE g.GROUP_ID = #{groupId}

SELECT g.GROUP_ID, g.TITLE, g.STATUS, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GYE_MEMBER x WHERE x.GROUP_ID = g.GROUP_ID AND x.STATUS = 'ACTIVE') AS MEMBER_COUNT, (SELECT MAX(c.SENT_AT) FROM CHAT_MESSAGE c WHERE c.GROUP_ID = g.GROUP_ID) AS LAST_SENT_AT, gm.CHAT_RESTRICTED_YN, AS LAST_CHAT_SANCTION FROM GYE_MEMBER gm JOIN GYE_GROUP g ON g.GROUP_ID = gm.GROUP_ID WHERE gm.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND gm.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY CASE WHEN g.STATUS = 'DISSOLVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, LAST_SENT_AT DESC NULLS LAST, g.GROUP_ID DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_MESSAGE (MESSAGE_ID, GROUP_ID, MEMBER_ID, BODY_ENC, KEY_VER, SENT_AT) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{groupId}, #{memberId}, #{bodyEnc}, #{keyVer}, #{sentAt})
mapper.select: SELECT NAME FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}

SELECT gm.MEMBER_ID, m.NAME, CASE WHEN g.OWNER_ID = gm.MEMBER_ID THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS LEADER, gm.JOINED_AT FROM GYE_MEMBER gm JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_ID = gm.MEMBER_ID JOIN GYE_GROUP g ON g.GROUP_ID = gm.GROUP_ID WHERE gm.GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND gm.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY LEADER DESC, gm.JOINED_AT, gm.MEMBER_ID
